name: Lesov Limb
source: One can only hear the rustle of branches high overhead and the sounds of an uneven tread on half-baked deadwood. You walk among the black trunks, and the forest breathes into your face a warm putrid smell of bogs and fallen leaves. Is it possible to get out of the forest? Or will your trail be lost forever in the predawn fog?
translation: 耳边只有高处枝叶的沙沙声，以及脚步不稳地踩过半干枯木的声音。你行走在漆黑的树干之间，森林将沼泽与落叶温热腐败的气息吹向你的脸。还能走出这片森林吗？还是说，你的踪迹终将永远消失在黎明前的浓雾中？
